Cancellation and refund policy

Live online purchases are currently closed.

Once the correct plan is activated

We do not offer voluntary refunds after we deliver and activate the plan as described. Completing the inquiry, using the documents, using only part of the access period or no longer needing the plan does not qualify for a change-of-mind refund.

Before paying

You can leave checkout before authorising payment. There is no automatic renewal. If your bank shows a debit and access is missing, contact support before trying to pay again.

Payment or delivery problems

Contact the support desk if you see a duplicate charge, paid for access you did not receive, or received a service that is deficient or materially different from the order. Include your order or payment reference and a brief description. We review these issues individually and provide any correction, refund or other remedy required under applicable law. If we cancel before supplying access, we will refund the captured amount. The website does not issue automatic or self-service refunds. This policy preserves mandatory rights and remedies.
